items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12

ctx.x: M-O-S-L-E-Y. M-O-S-L-E-Y. Where are you from? Evergreen, Alabama. Okay. And how do you spell your name?
V-R-T-H-U-N-E. Yeah, V-R-T-H-U-N-E. Yeah, V-R-T-H-U-N-E. Okay. Matthew Max was on that when I discovered his voice. Matthew Max?
He at Camp A now, he went by there. We talked to him today. We talked to him today.
